items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: But, Herschel Evans was a good tenor man with a lot of feeling.

ctx.x: Oh, tenor player. Oh, no. I thought when you said big tone, I was thinking of Shorty Baker.

Shorty Baker I knew. I knew him. He was short, all right. But, Herschel Evans was a good tenor man with a lot of feeling. That, the tune that actually, that brought, brings back was "Blue and Sentimental". I even hum it on the record.

All right. Are there any comments your would like to make, or observations that you would like to share with us on the Swing era or the big band era in general? You know, in terms of popularity or anything.
